Patient: Jonas Quintero | DOB: 09/22/1962 | MRN: SYN-1806176
Date of service: 07/06/2025 | Dr. Celine Merriweather, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
62-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 25 mg weekly for 28 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.7 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 7 days.
